subject: QuickBridge Hosted API evaluation — bundling teams & slot confirmation
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@quickbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-25T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: QuickBridge Hosted API eval — sandbox + 30m demo

Hi Emily,

Thanks for registering for the Hosted API evaluation — glad QuickBridge is trying the sandbox. I pulled your signup and it looks like your org already has the trial credits. Would you be available for a 30-minute walkthrough next week to run through the sandbox, token usage, and quick integration tips?

Two windows that work on our side (PDT):
- Tue 2029-06-03 — 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed 2029-06-04 — 11:00–11:30

If you want to include a second internal team (product + infra) we can bundle a slightly longer session. I cc'd Ben (AE) to coordinate bundling and any prework. I also attached a short POC checklist to help you prep.

Quick prework ask: can you share which model profile (throughput vs latency) you expect to test and whether you need EU region testing?

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachment: RB-QuickBridge-POC-Checklist.pdf

Hi Sean — thanks for the quick follow-up. I completed the self-serve signup earlier today.

We actually have two groups that want to join: product (me) and infra (Carlos). Would it be possible to do a single combined session so we don’t duplicate previews? If so, I think we’ll need ~45 minutes to cover integration questions and an extra 15 to validate sandbox credentials — so a 60-minute block total.

Prefer the afternoon slot on Tue 2029-06-03 (14:00 PDT) — the 10:00 slot conflicts with a board prep meeting. Also, can you add our security lead Priya Singh — she may have a short checklist on data retention and audit logs.

Attaching a quick attendee list and our org SSO domain.

Best,
Emily Zhao
Product Manager, QuickBridge

Hi Emily — great, thanks for confirming and for sharing the attendee list. Happy to bundle both teams into a single session. Proposed plan:

- 45 minute live demo (hosted API, routing, cost levers, and a short live call to your sandbox)
- 15 minute sandbox checkout + Q&A (confirm service account, keys, rate limits)

I can host the demo and Naomi (solutions engineer) will run the sandbox deep-dive for infra/security items.

Confirming Tue 2029-06-03 14:00–15:00 PDT works for us. I attached the calendar invite (please accept) and the POC checklist I mentioned earlier. If Priya wants to surface any security requirements earlier, we can also run a 15-minute pre-call with Naomi on Mon 2029-06-02.

A few logistics/questions:
- Do you want us to run the demo against your sandbox instance or our hosted demo data? (For security review we recommend using your sandbox.)
- What model profile should we load for the live run (balanced_latency, high_throughput, or smallest_cost)?

I'll update the HubSpot deal after we get the invite accepted.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
